title: Limit long file names to one line and display ellipsis
goal: combines available width, white-space, overflow, and text-overflow.
summary: The width of the exhibition download list is fixed. Long filenames display ellipsis at the end of the line, short filenames remain unchanged.
tasks: Limit the maximum width of .filename to 180px, disable line breaks, and hide overflow.
Use text-overflow to display ellipses, preserving full filenames in HTML.

example.note: Ellipses are only displayed when there is available width and inline text overflows.

hint: Writing text-overflow alone cannot generate ellipsis; it also needs to prevent text from wrapping and hide overflow.
